# `project`

`from project import ...` · source: `sdk/project.pyi`

The `project` module is GENERATED by `parallax check` from the project's data files.
This file only documents its shape; examples import it as if it had been generated.

```python
from project import Prefabs, Scenes, Placed, Assets, Content, Text, Dialogue, WorldLayers
```

```text
Prefabs.<id>                 PrefabRef      prefabs/<id>.prefab.json (features/*/prefabs/ too)
Scenes.<id>                  SceneRef       scenes/<id>/scene.json
Placed.<id>                  EntityRef      every placement with an "id" in any scene/region
Assets.<folder>.<name>       AssetRef       assets/<folder>/<name>.<ext>
                                              sfx/ → SoundRef, music/ → MusicRef,
                                              images/ → ImageRef, vfx/ → EffectRef,
                                              models/ → ModelRef with .clips.<clip> ClipRefs
Content.<kind>.<id>          ContentRef[T]  content/<kind>/<id>.json
Text.<key>                   TextRef        keys of locale/en.json (other languages are checked
                                              to have the same keys). Localized content/config
                                              fields add `<kind>.<id>.<field>` keys automatically.
Dialogue.<id>                DialogueRef    story/<id>.yarn
WorldLayers.<id>             WorldLayerRef  layers in any scene's world.json
```

Config documents are not in `project`: `@config("rules") class Rules` is read from
config/rules.json and accessed with `ctx.config(Rules)`.

Other data files the checker reads:

```text
assets/audio.json          default volume/pitch per sound, keyed "sfx/<name>" / "music/<name>";
                           each a number or a [lo, hi] range picked per play (variation)
scenes/<id>/scene.json     "tags": [...], "ui": [...], "music": "...", "environment": {...},
                           "init": {"run": {"level": 1}} — resource values applied when the
                           scene is opened directly (editor play button, a test) without init=
scenes/<id>/world.json     open worlds: cell size, streaming, layers + active_when
```

Ids are snake_case file names. A missing or renamed file is a check error at every use.
